protocol_text:
# Source-limited question-to-scoring scope audit

This protocol is fixed before the two new reviews and before scoring any newly
selected cohort. It adds a substantive audit of gaps not covered by the earlier
field-only diagnostic. The authors have already seen scores for Core, the
annotation-derived 133/208 and the field-review 67. This is therefore a subsequent
diagnostic, not a preregistered independent benchmark. The two fresh AI reviewers
receive no scores, predictions, previous judgments or demand annotations.

## Inputs and separation

Each reviewer receives all 133 original questions, executable reference queries,
returned columns and the declared scored answer column from the same immutable
source input. They may read this protocol and their supplied input only. They must
not inspect the prior field judgments, subset memberships, paper, evaluation
outputs, other reviewers or mock-review ratings. Two mutually isolated fresh AI
agents review all items. They are not people, independent 3GPP experts or a
practitioner-authored question source. No gold, question or prediction is rewritten.

The scoring rule is a normalized unordered set of values in one declared answer
column. Other returned fields, row order and multiplicity are ungraded. Query
execution fidelity and correctness of source records are outside this audit.

## Four axes

For every item, judge each axis as `compatible`, `incompatible` or `unclear`,
and give a reason containing verbatim question/query/column anchors. An
unverifiable interpretation is `unclear`, not assumed correct or counted as a
confirmed error. Extra unrequested RETURN columns alone are not an error.

1. `required_fields`: Does grading the declared column cover every requested
   output field or relationship role? Counting by entity needs the count as well
   as its entity if both are requested. A request for recipients is not satisfied
   by grading direction alone. Do not treat column-demand annotations as evidence.
2. `scope_and_roles`: Are explicit meeting, working-group, release, document,
   time, specification and relationship-role restrictions represented by the
   reference query? A conflicting literal/property/direction is incompatible.
   If domain assumptions or missing schema semantics prevent a supported
   judgment, use unclear; do not invent 3GPP knowledge or infer causal truth.
3. `cardinality_and_truncation`: Does the query's grouping/aggregation and LIMIT
   match the question's requested extent? Explicit top-k membership is compatible
   only when the requested k and selected k agree. Singular maximum/minimum must
   not silently become top-10. An unrestricted “list all” and unrequested finite
   LIMIT conflict. Bare “list” with unrequested LIMIT is unclear unless the
   question supplies its intended extent; the reviewer cannot infer that the
   underlying data contain no more rows than the limit. If handling a requested
   extremum or all ties cannot be established from the available sources, use
   unclear. COUNT of the filtered population does not request duplicate rows;
   grouping matters when asking counts per entity.
4. `ordering_and_duplicates`: Can the question's output requirement be met by an
   unordered set with duplicates removed? Explicit ranking, ordered trajectories,
   row positions or multiplicity are incompatible. An explicit top-k set need
   not be returned in order unless ranking/order is requested. Sorting inside the
   query alone does not imply an order requirement in the question. Requested
   unique identifiers or scalar counts can be compatible.

The overall status is compatible only when all four axes are compatible;
incompatible when any axis is incompatible; otherwise unclear. This is a
source-limited structural compatibility judgment, not full semantic certification.

## Selection, freezing and reporting

Select only the intersection of items whose overall status is compatible in
both reviews. No post-score adjudication, reroll or replacement of unfavorable
judgments is permitted. Publish all 133 per-axis judgments and exclusion reasons,
the protocol and source hashes, agreement and composition. Freeze the exact ID
list before calculating that cohort's new metrics, recording whether its new
score artifact was absent. Preserve all prior cohorts and their results.

If the intersection is empty, report that result and do not compute an empty
cohort score. If nonempty, use the same public offline scorer and seed-0/10,000
paired item-bootstrap procedure. Report answer-column/full-record comparisons,
all model intervals and original-text comparator limitations, including unfavorable
results. Never describe excluded items uniformly as confirmed semantic errors.

The scope must remain explicit in public documentation and rebuttal: fallible AI
judgments; no human expert validation; no new model/database runs; prior-parent
scores known to protocol designers; original questions unchanged; selected cohort
not representative without evidence; no transfer of scores to rewritten questions.

input.scoring_definition: Normalised unordered set of values in the declared answer column; other fields, row order and duplicates are not graded.

items.question: List the TDocs at meeting RAN1#120 tied to Work Item NR_eMIMO-Core (MIMO meeting preparation).
items.reference_query: MATCH (m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#120'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_eMIMO-Core'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

items.question: What is the final status of TDoc R1-2501234? (single-document status lookup)
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R1-2501234'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status LIMIT 1

items.question: What is the intended purpose (For) of TDoc R1-2501234 — Discussion, Approval, or Agreement?
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R1-2501234'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.for LIMIT 1

items.question: Who is the contact person for TDoc R1-2501234? (contact lookup)
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R1-2501234'})-[:HAS_CONTACT]->(ct:Contact) RETURN t.tdocNumber, ct.contactName LIMIT 1

items.question: List the TDocs postponed to the next meeting at RAN1#120 (tracking open items).
items.reference_query: MATCH (m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#120'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc {status: 'postponed'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

items.question: What was agreed on UL Tx switching (Agenda 5.1) at meeting RAN1#100? (UL switching decisions)
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '5.1'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#100'}) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY a.sequence LIMIT 10

items.question: List the conclusions reached at the latest meeting, RAN1#121 (status of open issues).
items.reference_query: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#121'}) RETURN c.resolutionId, c.content ORDER BY c.sequence, c.resolutionId LIMIT 15

items.question: List the working assumptions from meeting RAN1#115 (items that may be revisited).
items.reference_query: MATCH (wa:WorkingAssumption)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN1#115'}) RETURN wa.resolutionId, wa.content ORDER BY wa.sequence LIMIT 15

items.question: List the TDocs referenced by Agreement AGR-100-6.1-001 (tracing the source documents behind a decision).
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement {resolutionId: 'AGR-100-6.1-001'})-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, t.tdocNumber, t.title

items.question: Which agreement did TDoc R1-2001110 lead to? (tracing a contribution into the standard)
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R1-2001110'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content, m.meetingNumber

items.question: Which companies contributed most to resolutions under NR MIMO (Agenda 7.1)? Top 10.
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (a)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '7.1' RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT a) AS contributionCount ORDER BY contributionCount DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: List Qualcomm's 10 most recent agreements.
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Qualcomm'}), (a)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber, a.resolutionId LIMIT 10

items.question: Return the top-level table of contents of TS 38.214 (locating DL-scheduling content).
items.reference_query: MATCH (sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'})-[:HAS_SECTION]->(sec:Section) RETURN sec.sectionNumber, sec.sectionTitle ORDER BY sec.sectionNumber

items.question: How many CRs have been raised against TS 38.214? (how actively it is revised)
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) RETURN count(cr) AS totalCR

items.question: List the 20 most recent CRs modifying TS 38.213 (recent changes).
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) MATCH (cr)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title, co.companyName, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, cr.tdocNumber LIMIT 20

items.question: How many agreements approved CRs modifying TS 38.214? (how active decision-making is here)
items.reference_query: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCount

items.question: List the 10 most recent agreements affecting TS 38.213 (recent decisions).
items.reference_query: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) MATCH (agr)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT agr.resolutionId, COALESCE(agr.contentWithEquations, agr.content) AS content, m.meetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, agr.resolutionId LIMIT 10

items.question: Which TS 38.213 agreements still carry a TBD? (technical issues not yet settled)
items.reference_query: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) WHERE agr.hasTBD = true MATCH (agr)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT agr.resolutionId, COALESCE(agr.contentWithEquations, agr.content) AS content, m.meetingNumber, m.meetingNumberInt ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Which TS 38.213 resolutions mention HARQ? (tracing HARQ-related decisions)
items.reference_query: MATCH (res:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.213'}) WHERE COALESCE(res.contentWithEquations, res.content, '') =~ '(?i).*HARQ.*' MATCH (res)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN [lbl IN ['Resolution','Agreement','Conclusion','WorkingAssumption'] WHERE lbl IN labels(res)] AS type, res.resolutionId, COALESCE(res.contentWithEquations, res.content) AS content, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, res.resolutionId LIMIT 10

items.question: Do the disjointWith relations between Features (LTM, CHO, CPC, CPAC, etc.) match the feature catalog's disjoint groups? (consistency check)
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Feature)-[:disjointWith]->(b:Feature) WHERE a.name < b.name RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b ORDER BY a, b

items.question: List the most recently submitted TDocs targeting Rel-19 (latest Rel-19 activity).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName: 'Rel-19'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type, t.status, m.canonicalMeetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

items.question: Return the decision status of TDoc R2-2509337 (outcome lookup).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, t.type LIMIT 1

items.question: Return the intended purpose (the 'For' field) of TDoc R2-2509337 (contribution intent).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2509337'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.`for` LIMIT 1

items.question: List the TDocs postponed to a later meeting at RAN2#131 (deferred-item tracking).
items.reference_query: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#131'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc) WHERE t.status = 'postponed' RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.type ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 10

items.question: Summarize the outcomes of Samsung's contributions at RAN2#132 (meeting result summary).
items.reference_query: MATCH (m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'})<-[:PRESENTED_AT]-(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}) RETURN t.status, count(t) AS count ORDER BY count DESC

items.question: Return resolution counts by type at meeting RAN2#132 (meeting decision mix).
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#132'}) RETURN CASE WHEN r:Agreement THEN 'Agreement' WHEN r:Conclusion THEN 'Conclusion' WHEN r:WorkingAssumption THEN 'WorkingAssumption' END AS type, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

items.question: List the conclusions drawn at meeting RAN2#121 (study-outcome review).
items.reference_query: MATCH (c:Conclusion)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#121'}) RETURN c.resolutionId, c.content, c.hasConsensus ORDER BY c.sequence LIMIT 10

items.question: List the working assumptions from meeting RAN2#115 (provisional-decision review).
items.reference_query: MATCH (wa:WorkingAssumption)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {canonicalMeetingNumber: 'RAN2#115'}) RETURN wa.resolutionId, wa.content ORDER BY wa.sequence LIMIT 15

items.question: List the TDocs referenced by Agreement AGR-132-8.13-005 (decision provenance).
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement {resolutionId: 'AGR-132-8.13-005'})-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) RETURN a.resolutionId, a.content, t.tdocNumber, t.title

items.question: List the agreements flagging items for comeback (deferred-decision tracking).
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'comeback' RETURN a.resolutionId, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Which resolutions did TDoc R2-2500064 lead to (contribution-to-decision trace)?
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R2-2500064'}), (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN t.tdocNumber, r.resolutionId, labels(r) AS type, m.canonicalMeetingNumber, r.content

items.question: Rank the main contributors to spec 38.331 (RRC ownership).
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS contributions ORDER BY contributions DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Return the section-level distribution of spec 38.331 (structural depth profile).
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}) RETURN s.level, count(s) AS cnt ORDER BY s.level

items.question: Return the total counts of sections, tables, and figures (corpus size).
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Section) WITH count(s) AS secCnt MATCH (t:TSTable) WITH secCnt, count(t) AS tblCnt MATCH (f:TSFigure) WITH secCnt, tblCnt, count(f) AS figCnt RETURN secCnt, tblCnt, figCnt

items.question: Return the cross-spec references from spec 38.300 into spec 38.331 (inter-spec dependency).
items.reference_query: MATCH (s1:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp1:Spec {specNumber: '38.300'}), (s1)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(s2:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}) RETURN s1.sectionId AS from_section, s2.sectionId AS to_section LIMIT 10

items.question: Return the total number of section-to-section references (cross-reference volume).
items.reference_query: MATCH ()-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->() RETURN count(*) AS totalRefs

items.question: Which spec does CR R2-2509337 modify (change target)?
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE cr.tdocNumber = 'R2-2509337' RETURN sp.specNumber

items.question: Return the total number of CRs modifying spec 38.331 (change volume).
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}) RETURN count(cr) AS totalCRs

items.question: Do the disjointWith relations among features (LTM, CHO, CPC, CPAC, etc.) match feature_catalog.disjoint_feature_groups (consistency check)?
items.reference_query: MATCH (a:Feature)-[:disjointWith]->(b:Feature) WHERE a.name < b.name RETURN a.name AS a, b.name AS b ORDER BY a, b

items.question: Are the 28 LTM capability items loaded as CapabilityItem nodes (LTM baseline check)?
items.reference_query: MATCH (cap:CapabilityItem) WHERE cap.capabilityItemName STARTS WITH 'ltm-' AND cap.granularity = 'item' RETURN count(cap) AS ltm_cap_count, collect(cap.capabilityItemName)[..10] AS sample

items.question: List the CRs that name spec 38.212 as an affected spec (incoming impact).
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Spec {specNumber: '38.212'})<-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Return the top 10 CRs by cross-spec impact count (widest-reaching CRs).
items.reference_query: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->() WITH c, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.tdocNumber LIMIT 10 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, cnt

items.question: Return the impact-type breakdown of TR 38.804 (impact profile).
items.reference_query:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.804'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)
                  RETURN imp.impactType, count(imp) AS cnt

items.question: Return the decision status of TDoc R3-258530 (checking the outcome).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R3-258530'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.status, t.type

items.question: Return the 'For' purpose of TDoc R3-258530 (identifying document intent).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R3-258530'}) RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.for

items.question: Return the predecessor revision of TDoc R3-241531 (revision-lineage tracing).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R3-241531'})-[:IS_REVISION_OF]->(prev:Tdoc) RETURN t.tdocNumber, prev.tdocNumber, prev.title

items.question: Return the LS that TDoc R3-241518 replies to (liaison reply linkage).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc {tdocNumber: 'R3-241518'})-[:REPLY_TO]->(orig:Tdoc) RETURN t.tdocNumber, orig.tdocNumber, orig.title

items.question: Return the specs that CR R3-258530 modifies (change-impact scope).
items.reference_query: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R3-258530'})-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec) RETURN c.tdocNumber, s.specNumber

items.question: List the TDocs postponed at meeting RAN3#121bis (deferred-item tracking).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumberInt: 121}) WHERE t.status = 'postponed' RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title LIMIT 10

items.question: Break down contributions by company under agenda item 8.1 at meeting RAN3#130 (competitive landscape).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '8.1'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumberInt: 130}), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Count contributions per company on Work Item NR_newRAT-Core (participation ranking).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (t)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem {workItemCode: 'NR_newRAT-Core'}) RETURN c.companyName, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Summarize the outcomes of Samsung's contributions at meeting RAN3#130 (result rollup by status).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName: 'Samsung'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumberInt: 130}) RETURN t.status, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

items.question: List the not-treated TDocs under agenda item 13.2 at meeting RAN3#122 (pending-item tracking).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(a:AgendaItem {agendaNumber: '13.2'}), (t)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumberInt: 122}) WHERE t.status = 'not treated' RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title LIMIT 10

items.question: Return the top 10 agenda items by resolution count (busiest agenda areas).
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) RETURN ai.agendaNumber, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, ai.agendaNumber LIMIT 10

items.question: Find resolutions whose text cites R3- TDoc numbers (in-text reference check).
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution) WHERE r.content IS NOT NULL AND r.content =~ '.*R3-.*' RETURN r.resolutionId, r.content ORDER BY r.resolutionId LIMIT 5

items.question: Return the top 10 companies by resolution contribution (influence ranking).
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10

items.question: Rank the main contributors to spec 38.423 (spec-ownership analysis).
items.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.423'}) MATCH (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10

items.question: Return the top 10 companies by moderator assignments (leadership distribution).
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Summary)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(s) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10

items.question: Show the section-level distribution in spec 38.423 (structural-depth profile).
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.423'}) RETURN s.level, count(s) AS cnt ORDER BY s.level

items.question: Return the total counts of sections, tables, and figures (corpus-size overview).
items.reference_query: MATCH (s:Section) WITH count(s) AS secCnt MATCH (t:TSTable) WITH secCnt, count(t) AS tblCnt MATCH (f:TSFigure) WITH secCnt, tblCnt, count(f) AS figCnt RETURN secCnt, tblCnt, figCnt

items.question: Return the total number of section cross-references (reference-graph size).
items.reference_query: MATCH ()-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->() RETURN count(*) AS totalRefs

items.question: Return the total number of CRs modifying spec 38.423 (change-volume metric).
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.423'}) RETURN count(cr) AS totalCRs

items.question: List the other specs affected by CR R3-244680 (cross-spec impact).
items.reference_query: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) WHERE c.tdocNumber = 'R3-244680' RETURN c.tdocNumber, type(r) AS relType, s.specNumber ORDER BY s.specNumber

items.question: Return the top 10 CRs by cross-spec impact count (widest-reaching changes).
items.reference_query: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->() WITH c, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, c.tdocNumber LIMIT 10 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, cnt

items.question: Show the status distribution across all TRs (study-progress overview).
items.reference_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport) RETURN tr.trStatus, count(tr) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC

items.question: Return the impact types recorded for TR 38.801 (impact-category profile).
items.reference_query:
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.801'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)
                  RETURN imp.impactType, count(imp) AS cnt

items.question: List the TRs that impacted spec 38.401 (spec-provenance in studies).
items.reference_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.401'}) RETURN tr.trNumber, imp.impactType, imp.impactDescription

items.question: Return the top 5 TRs by number of spec impacts (highest-impact studies).
items.reference_query: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact) RETURN tr.trNumber, count(imp) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, tr.trNumber LIMIT 5

items.question: Return the details of CR R4-2419229 and the spec it modifies (change-request lookup).
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR {tdocNumber:'R4-2419229'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN cr.tdocNumber, cr.title, sp.specNumber

items.question: List the top 5 meetings by number of TDocs (busiest meetings).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:PRESENTED_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN m.canonicalMeetingNumber, count(t) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: How many TDocs target Rel-18? (release workload sizing).
items.reference_query: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(r:Release {releaseName:'Rel-18'}) RETURN count(t) AS cnt

items.question: List the top 10 companies by CR contributions (leading CR contributors).
items.reference_query: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) RETURN c.companyName, count(cr) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10
